countries.name: Japan
countries.overview: Japan rewards slow travelers: ancient shrines a short walk from neon streets, mountain hot springs, and some of the best everyday food anywhere. Trains make it easy to move between big cities and small towns.
highlights: Island hopping in the Seto Inland Sea

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.overview: From misty northern mountains to the river deltas of the south, Vietnam is long, green and full of flavor. Mornings start with noodle soup and coffee on a plastic stool.
countries.season: Varies by region; spring is pleasant across most of the country

countries.name: Italy
countries.tagline: Hill towns, cypress roads and long lunches
countries.overview: Italy is many countries in one: Alpine lakes, Renaissance cities, olive groves and island coastlines. Travel by regional train and let the meals set the pace.
countries.season: April to June and September to October

countries.name: Portugal
countries.overview: Portugal mixes hillside cities, wild surf beaches and quiet wine valleys. The light here is soft and golden, and the pastries are hard to resist.

countries.name: Iceland
countries.overview: Iceland is raw and elemental: black-sand beaches, roaring waterfalls and lava fields under huge skies. Weather changes fast, so plan with flexibility.
countries.season: Summer for long days; winter for northern lights

countries.name: Greece
countries.overview: Greece is sea, stone and sunshine. Island ferries connect whitewashed villages, ancient ruins sit beside busy cafes, and dinner starts late.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.overview: Morocco moves from busy medinas to silent desert in a day's drive. Mint tea is a welcome, and riads hide calm courtyards behind plain walls.
highlights: A night in the Sahara dunes

countries.name: Kenya
countries.overview: Kenya is about early starts and wide horizons: savanna game drives, highland tea country and a long Indian Ocean coast.
countries.season: The dry seasons, roughly July to October and January to February

countries.name: Peru
countries.overview: Peru stacks deserts, high Andes and Amazon rainforest into one country. Take the altitude slowly and save room for one of the world's great food scenes.
countries.season: May to September in the Andes
highlights: Ancient terraces in the Sacred Valley

countries.name: Mexico
countries.overview: Mexico is vast and generous: ancient pyramids, colonial towns painted every color, and swimming holes in the jungle. Every region has its own cooking.
countries.season: November to April for most regions

countries.name: Canada
countries.overview: Canada's scale is the point: turquoise lakes, endless forest and mountain highways. Cities are friendly and the wilderness starts right outside them.
countries.season: June to September for the mountains

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.overview: New Zealand packs fjords, volcanoes, beaches and alpine passes into two islands. Hit the trails, then warm up in a small-town bakery.

tips.title: Share your plans
tips.text: Send your route and stays to someone at home, and check in at set times.

tips.title: Choose social stays
tips.text: Small guesthouses and hostels with common rooms make it easy to meet people.

tips.title: Eat at the counter
tips.text: Counter seats and market stalls turn solo meals into conversations.

tips.title: Trust your instincts
tips.text: If a place or offer feels wrong, leave. You never owe anyone an explanation.

tips.title: Plan one anchor a day
tips.text: One booked activity gives each day shape without over-planning.

tips.title: Split the planning
tips.text: Each person plans a few days. You'll both get surprises.

tips.title: Build in alone time
tips.text: An afternoon apart makes dinner together better.

tips.title: Pick one splurge
tips.text: Choose one special night or meal and keep the rest simple.

tips.title: Agree on a pace
tips.text: Talk early about early starts, rest days and budget.

tips.title: Pack one shared bag
tips.text: One bag for chargers, snacks and documents saves a lot of searching.

tips.title: Fewer bases, longer stays
tips.text: Moving every day is hard with kids. Stay three nights or more.

tips.title: Plan around naps and meals
tips.text: Big sights in the morning, slow afternoons, early dinners.

tips.title: Let kids choose
tips.text: Give children one pick each day — a museum, a park, a snack.

tips.title: Pack a calm-down kit
tips.text: Headphones, a favorite snack and a small game fix most travel moods.

tips.title: Book family rooms early
tips.text: Rooms that sleep four are limited; reserve them first.

tips.title: Pack light, then lighter
tips.text: Lay everything out, then remove a third of it.

tips.title: Use overnight transport
tips.text: Night buses and trains save a night of accommodation.

tips.title: Cook sometimes
tips.text: Hostel kitchens and markets stretch a budget further than anything.

tips.title: Carry a small lock
tips.text: Lockers in dorms often need your own padlock.

tips.title: Keep a buffer day
tips.text: Leave one unplanned day each week for delays or a place you love.

tips.title: Book direct
tips.text: Hotels often add upgrades or late checkout for direct bookings.

tips.title: Use a local guide
tips.text: A great guide is the best luxury: context, access and time saved.

tips.title: Travel off-peak
tips.text: Shoulder seasons bring better rooms and quieter places.

tips.title: Plan arrivals
tips.text: Arrange transfers so the first hour of the trip is easy.

tips.title: Leave space
tips.text: Luxury is unhurried time — keep afternoons free.

tips.title: Train before you go
tips.text: Practice with your pack and boots on real hills.

tips.title: Check conditions daily
tips.text: Weather, trail and water conditions change fast.

tips.title: Hire local experts
tips.text: Mountain and water guides know what maps don't.

tips.title: Carry the basics
tips.text: Headlamp, layers, first-aid kit and extra water, every time.

tips.title: Know your turnaround time
tips.text: Decide in advance when you'll head back, whatever happens.

tips.title: Follow the queue
tips.text: A line of locals at lunch is the best review.

tips.title: Take a market tour
tips.text: A morning with a cook teaches you what to order all trip.

tips.title: Eat at lunch
tips.text: Many famous restaurants offer lunch menus at a fraction of dinner prices.

tips.title: Learn five food words
tips.text: Knowing the words for local dishes opens every menu.

tips.title: Ask what's in season
tips.text: The best dish is usually the one made with this week's produce.

tips.title: Test the internet first
tips.text: Ask hosts for a speed test screenshot before you book.

tips.title: Keep home-time hours
tips.text: Block meetings in a window that works for both time zones.

tips.title: Choose monthly stays
tips.text: Longer stays lower costs and make a routine easier.

tips.title: Pack a travel desk kit
tips.text: Laptop stand, compact keyboard and a long charging cable.

tips.title: Protect weekends
tips.text: Explore on days off so travel doesn't become just work elsewhere.
